exact_family_theorem: For every prime p>=17, the preregistered finite-field construction defines a canonical signed exact simple 3-CNF F_p with 3p variables and 15p clauses, connected linear 15-regular incidence structure and exact 7/8 sign split; the family is infinite/unbounded and every member is a one-cycle unchanged STALLED_PORTFOLIO_FIXPOINT of the exact frozen reducer.

argument: By cyclicity of F_p^*, a primitive root exists; the least positive such root g_p is therefore well-defined.
Its multiplicative order is exactly p-1. For p>=17, p-1>=16.
If 0<=j<k<=14 and g_p^j=g_p^k, then g_p^(k-j)=1 with 1<=k-j<=14<p-1, contradicting ord_p(g_p)=p-1. Hence s_0,...,s_14 are pairwise distinct.
Euclid's infinitude-of-primes theorem gives infinitely many primes.
Only finitely many primes are <17, so deleting them leaves infinitely many primes p>=17.
A_p,B_p,C_p are disjoint copies of F_p and each has p elements, so |V(F_p)|=3p.
Along the infinite prime index set p is unbounded, hence 3p tends to infinity.
After E8, the 15p indexed blocks are distinct, so |C(F_p)|=15p and there are 45p literal occurrences.
E_{x,j} contains A_x, B_{x+s_j}, C_{x+2s_j}.
The A,B,C parts are disjoint by definition, so these are three distinct variable identities regardless of their field coordinates.
Thus every clause is exact width 3 with no repeated variable identity.
Fix j. A_a occurs exactly in E_{a,j}.
B_b occurs exactly in E_{b-s_j,j}, since x+s_j=b has the unique solution x=b-s_j in F_p.
C_c occurs exactly in E_{c-2s_j,j}, since p>=17 is odd and x+2s_j=c has the unique solution x=c-2s_j.
There are exactly 15 j-values, so every variable occurs exactly once for each j and has degree 15.
Let E_{x,j},E_{y,k} share two variables. Shared A+B gives x=y and x+s_j=y+s_k, hence s_j=s_k, then j=k by SLOPE and x=y.
Shared A+C gives x=y and 2s_j=2s_k; since p is odd, 2 is invertible, so s_j=s_k, j=k.
Shared B+C gives x+s_j=y+s_k and x+2s_j=y+2s_k; subtracting yields s_j=s_k, then j=k, and then x=y.
Any two shared parts therefore force identical block indices. Hence distinct blocks share at most one variable.
Choose fixed distinct j,k and let d=s_j-s_k, nonzero by SLOPE.
For every x, the incidence path A_x--E_{x,j}--B_{x+s_j}--E_{x+d,k}--A_{x+d} exists because (x+d)+s_k=x+s_j.
Thus A_x is connected to A_{x+td} for every integer t.
The additive group F_p has prime order; every nonzero d generates it additively, so all A-vertices lie in one component.
For any B_b and any j, B_b lies in E_{b-s_j,j}, which also contains A_{b-s_j}; hence every B attaches to the A-component.
For any C_c and any j, C_c lies in E_{c-2s_j,j}, which also contains A_{c-2s_j}; hence every C attaches too.
Therefore the incidence graph is connected and its unique variable-containing component has all 3p variables; bounded-size disconnected gadget repetition is excluded.
By E4, each variable occurs exactly once for every j=0,...,14.
The frozen sign rule is positive for exactly j=0,...,6 and negative for exactly j=7,...,14.
Therefore each variable has exactly 7 positive and 8 negative occurrences.
Suppose two unsigned triples E_{x,j}=E_{y,k}.
Because the three parts are disjoint, equality of triples forces equality partwise, in particular A_x=A_y and hence x=y.
Then B_{x+s_j}=B_{x+s_k}, so s_j=s_k; SLOPE gives j=k.
Thus the block-index map is injective and there are exactly 15p distinct unsigned triples/clauses.
For prime p, T_FP_MULTIPLICATIVE_CYCLIC guarantees at least one primitive root, so increasing scan g=2,...,p-1 terminates at the least primitive root.
Primality of p and factorization of p-1 may be done deterministically by trial division using time polynomial in p; this gate makes no poly(log p) claim.

Given the distinct prime divisors q of p-1, g is primitive iff g^((p-1)/q) != 1 mod p for every q; modular exponentiation is deterministic polynomial in log p, and scanning at most p candidates remains polynomial in p.
Computing 15 slopes and emitting exactly 15p clauses costs polynomial time in p; canonical sorting/serialization of O(p) clauses with O(log p)-bit identifiers is also polynomial in p.
The textual output length is Theta(p log p) bits (and at least Theta(p) records), so any polynomial in p is polynomial in the output size. No stronger binary-input complexity claim is promoted.
E3 gives exact simple 3-CNF; E5 gives linearity; E4 gives exact degree 15; E7 gives exact 7/8 polarity split; E8 excludes duplicate variable triples.
